title: Shannon McMinimee Time Audit (Bellevue GC / Vancouver Matter)

communications.subject: Washington Public Records Act Request: Shannon McMinimee Time Audit (Bellevue GC / Vancouver Matter)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Washington Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Public business and personnel records regarding the former Interim General Counsel for the Bellevue School District (BSD), Shannon M. McMinimee (WSBA #34471).

Context for Request:

Publicly available records from administrative proceedings involving Vancouver Public Schools indicate a concurrent timeline of outside private practice representation by Ms. McMinimee (operating as McMinimee Law PLLC) during her active employment window with BSD (January 2022 through June 2025). Correspondence and metadata from those proceedings indicate active private case management occurring during standard public administrative business hours.

To evaluate compliance with district policies regarding outside employment, public resource use, and time accounting, I request the following records spanning January 1, 2022, through June 30, 2025:

1. Time and Attendance Logs: Timesheets, payroll hours, calendar entries, or leaves of absence (including vacation, personal, or sick time) submitted by or for Shannon McMinimee on the following specific dates where outside correspondence was recorded:
• August 8, 2022: Track hours between 1:00 PM and 6:00 PM PT (Emails sent at 2:54 PM and 5:12 PM)
• August 9, 2022: Track hours between 3:00 PM and 6:00 PM PT (Email sent at 4:46 PM)
• August 12, 2022: Track hours between 11:00 AM and 5:30 PM PT (Emails sent at 12:00 PM, 3:53 PM, and 4:26 PM)
• August 15, 2022: Track hours between 8:30 AM and 11:30 AM PT (Email sent at 9:42 AM)
• August 16, 2022: Track hours between 8:00 AM and 6:00 PM PT (Emails sent at 9:04 AM, 2:31 PM, and 4:50 PM)
• August 19, 2022: Track hours between 4:30 PM and 6:00 PM PT (Email sent at 5:47 PM)
• August 22, 2022: Track hours between 2:30 PM and 6:00 PM PT (Emails sent at 3:34 PM and 5:51 PM)
• August 25, 2022: Track hours between 4:30 PM and 6:00 PM PT (Email sent at 5:22 PM)

2. Outside Employment and Conflict Disclosures: Any conflict-of-interest disclosure forms, outside employment authorization requests, dual-employment waivers, or district board approval records filed by or regarding Ms. McMinimee concerning her private firm, McMinimee Law PLLC.

3. District Network/Device Activity Logs: Automated network routing logs or device metadata from district-issued computers assigned to Ms. McMinimee during the specific dates and timeframes listed in Item 1, restricted strictly to identifying whether network connections were routed to external private litigation tools, platforms, or outside administrative bodies.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Kung Fu Joe
